name: Sphere of Annihilation

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Control the sphere
powers.text: Magic action: a DC 25 Intelligence (Arcana) check moves it 5 ft + 5 ft per Int modifier; anything in its path is annihilated (4d10 Force to creatures, DC 13 Dex).

summary: A 2-ft hole of nothing that annihilates whatever it touches; with luck and Arcana you can steer it.
text: A black sphere 2 feet across, this is a hole torn in the multiverse, floating in place and held stable by a surrounding magical field. Any matter it moves through, or that moves through it, is annihilated, except Artifacts: unless an Artifact can specifically be harmed by such a sphere, it slips through unharmed. Anything else that contacts the sphere without being fully engulfed and destroyed takes 4d10 Force damage. An uncontrolled sphere stays where it is. From up to 60 feet away, a Magic action lets you try to move it with an Intelligence (Arcana) check against DC 25. On a success it drifts up to 5 feet per point of your Intelligence modifier (at least 5 feet) in whatever direction you pick; on a failure it moves 10 feet toward you. When the sphere enters a creature's space, that creature must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC 13) or be touched by it and take 4d10 Force damage.
